title: Business ka structure kaun sa chunna chahiye?
hooks: Business start karna hai — structure kaun sa chune?
Dukaan kholni ya startup? Structure decide karega risk
Proprietorship, LLP, Pvt Ltd — asli difference kya hai?
hook_why: Direct question mirrors viewer's dilemma; first 4 words carry problem and surprise.
metaphor: Phone screen shows founder's real chat, SMS, app screens — viewer sees exactly what founder sees.

claims.claim: Proprietorship has no separate legal entity; owner has unlimited liability
claims.basis: taxgst.in comparison table: 'Separate legal entity: No', 'Liability: Unlimited — personal assets exposed'

claims.claim: Partnership governed by Indian Partnership Act, 1932; joint & several unlimited liability
claims.basis: taxgst.in: 'Governing law: Indian Partnership Act, 1932', 'Liability: Unlimited, joint and several'

claims.claim: LLP is separate legal entity under LLP Act, 2008; liability limited to contribution
claims.basis: taxgst.in: 'Separate legal entity: Yes', 'Liability: Limited to the agreed contribution'; rdatax.in: 'LLP — separate legal entity with limited liability'

claims.basis: Companies Act 2013, Section 2(62); Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014, Rule 3
